description: This header file defines the interface for a plugin module related to SNMP in an advanced networking service container. It declares external C functions for initializing, checking object support, unloading, and memory diagnostics of the plugin, with licensing and author information provided.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the maximum supported version and plugin info.

methods.name: COSA_Async_Init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization of the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific object is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Retrieves memory details related to the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryTable
methods.description: Gets memory table information maintained by the plugin.
